about: Log signatures: a regular expression (Java syntax) and what it means. Groups name the culprits and details. Rules marked codex-minecraft are adapted from https://github.com/aternosorg/codex-minecraft (MIT, Copyright (c) 2019-2025 Aternos GmbH).

signatures.pattern: UnsatisfiedLinkError: Failed to locate library: (lib)?(lwjgl[\w]*)\.(so|dylib|dll)
signatures.source: lab: Minecraft 1.21.1 client on Linux ARM64 (Mojang ships LWJGL natives for Linux x86-64 only)

signatures.pattern: Failed to remap plugin jar '(?:plugins/)?([^']+\.jar)'[\s\S]{0,4000}?Unsupported class file major version (\d+)
signatures.source: lab: paper-decentholograms (DecentHolograms 2.10.1 on Paper 1.21.1 is silently not loaded)

signatures.pattern: The mod (\S+) does not wish to run in Minecraft version Minecraft ([0-9.]+)
Mod '([^']+)' \(([\w.-]+)\) \S+ is incompatible with version ([^\n]*?) of mod '([^']+)' \(([\w.-]+)\)
signatures.source: https://github.com/IrisShaders/Iris/issues/3349 and Sodium's own fabric.mod.json, where the breaks clause names the version of the other mod it refuses (replayed in the lab)

signatures.pattern: ResolutionException: Modules (\S+) and (\S+) export package (\S+) to module
ResolutionException: Module (\S+) contains package (\S+), module (\S+) exports package
Could not execute entrypoint stage '[^']+' due to errors, provided by '([\w.-]+)'
Caught exception from (?:mod )?([^(\n]+?) \(([\w.-]+)\)
(?m)^\s*(?:Failure message: )?([^(\n]+?) \(([\w.-]+)\) has failed to load correctly
Missing language ([\w-]+) version \[([^\]]+)\] wanted by (?:\S*/)?([^/\n]+?\.jar), found (\S+)
signatures.source: https://github.com/legoaggelos/densefuel/issues/1 (replayed in the lab: NeoForge 21.1.236, javafml 4.0.43 against a mod asking for 4.0.44)

signatures.pattern: Mod File (?:\S*/)?([^/\n]+?\.jar) needs language provider ([\w-]+):(\S+?) to load

The world '([^']+)' could NOT be loaded because it contains errors and is probably corrupt
Couldn't load chunk \[?(-?\d+, ?-?\d+)\]?

Error occurred while disabling (\S+) [^(\n]*\(Is it up to date\?\)
Your configuration must be fixed before PEX will enable

\*\*\*\* FAILED TO BIND TO PORT!|Failed to bind to port|(?:BindException|bind\(\.\.\) failed): Address already in use

(?:Exception reading|Failed to (?:load|read)) [^\n]*?([^\s/]+)/level\.dat

Failed to load config (([a-z][a-z0-9_]+)(?:-[\w-]+)?\.toml): [\w.]*ParsingException: ([^\n]+?)\. Attempting to recreate
signatures.source: lab: config-mod-broken (NeoForge 1.21.1 replaces a broken supplementaries-common.toml with the defaults)

signatures.pattern: Cannot load (plugins/(\w+)/\S+\.yml)
Unable to read or access the world gen settings file![^\n]*?([\w./-]*world_gen_settings\.dat)
signatures.source: https://github.com/PaperMC/Paper/issues/14066 (replayed in the lab: Paper 26.2 with that file deleted)

signatures.pattern: (?:Parsing error loading recipe|Error parsing recipe) ([\w.-]+:[\w./-]+)[\s\S]{0,200}?No key id in MapLike
signatures.source: https://github.com/misode/misode.github.io/issues/822 and https://github.com/BaiTian6641/farmer-s-respite/issues/1 (replayed in the lab: a 1.20.4-style recipe on Paper 1.21.1)

signatures.pattern: Failed to load datapacks, can't proceed with server load
Couldn't parse (?:data file|element) ([\w.-]+:[\w./-]+) from ([\w.-]+:[\w./-]+)
Parsing error loading (recipe|advancement|loot table|[\w ]+?) (([\w.-]+):[\w./-]+)
signatures.source: lab: datapack-broken (vanilla 1.21.1 skips a recipe that names an unknown item)

signatures.pattern: (?:disconnected while connecting to (\S+)|Unable to connect to (\S+)|Disconnecting \S+ \([^)]*\)|lost connection): Unable to verify player details
signatures.source: lab: net proxy-secret-mismatch (Velocity 3.4.0 and Paper 1.21.1 with different forwarding secrets; same line on the player, the proxy and the server)
lab: net proxy-backend-down (Velocity 3.4.0 whose [servers] entry names a server that is not running)

signatures.pattern: This server requires you to connect with Velocity
signatures.source: https://github.com/PaperMC/Velocity/issues/1347 (replayed in the lab: a proxy left in "none" mode in front of a server that waits for Velocity)

signatures.pattern: Unable to connect you to (\S+?)\. Please try again later|Could not connect to a default or fallback server
signatures.source: lab: net proxy-backend-down (message the player gets from Velocity; the second is BungeeCord's)

signatures.source: lab: net mod-missing-on-client (Fabric 1.21.1 server with Farmer's Delight Refabricated, player without it)

signatures.pattern: Mod '([\w-]+)' is incompatible with '([\w-]+)', versions: '[^']*'; Version found: '([^']*)'

signatures.pattern: The forwarding-secret file must not be empty
signatures.source: https://forums.papermc.io/threads/how-to-solve-unable-to-read-load-save-your-velocity-toml.339/ (replayed in the lab: Velocity 3.4.0, modern forwarding, empty forwarding.secret)

signatures.pattern: java\.nio\.file\.AccessDeniedException:\s*(\S+)
signatures.source: https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/issues/1080 (replayed in the lab: the world folder made unreadable for the user the server runs as)

signatures.source: https://github.com/Flemmli97/TenshiLib/issues/17 and https://github.com/TeamMidnightDust/MidnightLib/issues/145 (replayed in the lab: TenshiLib 2.3.0 on NeoForge 1.21.1, whose version range is impossible)

signatures.pattern: (Connector) locator error
signatures.source: https://github.com/Sinytra/Connector/issues/2002 (replayed in the lab: Connector 2.0.0-beta.10 on NeoForge 1.21.1 with the Forgified Fabric API and Axiom)

signatures.pattern: Unknown data in login hostname, did you forget to enable BungeeCord in spigot\.yml
signatures.source: https://docs.papermc.io/velocity/faq/ (replayed in the lab: BungeeCord with ip_forward on, backend spigot.yml with bungeecord off)

signatures.pattern: Velocity (?:support )?is enabled, but no secret key was specified

signatures.pattern: No rcon password set in server\.properties, rcon disabled!

signatures.pattern: Failed to find a valid GLFW profile

signatures.pattern: GLFW error (\d+): ((?:WGL|GLX|EGL|X11|Wayland|Win32)[^\n]*)

signatures.pattern: Removed resource pack (file/\S+) from options because it is no longer compatible

signatures.pattern: Picked up (_JAVA_OPTIONS|JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS):\s*([^\n]*)

signatures.pattern: Enabling removal of erroring (Entities|Tile Entities) - USE AT YOUR OWN RISK
signatures.source: Forge's own config text ("BE WARNED THIS COULD SCREW UP EVERYTHING") and the patch that calls discard() on the entity instead of reporting the crash
